scripts.dev: npm run dev -w client & npm run dev -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.replit:build: npm install && cd client && npx vite build && cd ../server && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --packages=external
scripts.replit:start: cd server && NODE_ENV=production PORT=5000 SQLITE_PATH=../dev.db node dist/index.js
